summary: Iteration 16 (v0.5.2-Beta) tested successfully — backend 18/18 pytest cases pass, frontend all targeted UI checks pass. New ROLE_FINANCIEN correctly present in /api/admin/roles (7 roles total, financien has ['analytics','financials']; super_admin/beheerder both include 'financials'). /api/admin/financials returns emergent_ai (messages/estimated_eur/usd/credits), zoho_books (mocked:true, invoiced/paid/outstanding/overdue/top_clients), totals (combined_income_eur/combined_costs_eur/estimated_margin_eur); period=7d→days=7, 30d→30, custom 2025-01-01..01-31→30. Moderator gets 403. /api/quote accepts wishlist_items+wishlist_totals+story and echoes them back. /api/chat/rating {rating:5} returns saved+id; /api/admin/chat/ratings returns total/avg/counts{1..5}/per_day/recent; rating=0 and rating=6 → 422. Brevo api_key stored 'enc:...' (Fernet), GET never exposes raw key. Mailbox password stored 'enc:...'; duplicate email POST → 409. Regressions OK (/api/projects, /api/reviews, /api/admin/counters, /api/chat, /api/newsletter/subscribe, /api/telemetry/captcha-verified). Frontend: /prijslijst has 3 service tabs, calculator modal opens; pricing-calc-service-total-web MID BLOCK REMOVED as spec; category subtotals render when qty>0 (pricing-calc-cat-subtotal-<cat>); pricing-calc-request-quote opens quote-from-calc-modal; submitting name+email+story POSTs /api/quote (200) and shows toast 'Quote request sent'. /admin/financials renders cms-financials, financials-total-income/costs/margin cards, all 9 period buttons (7d/30d/90d/6m/1y/2y/3y/5y/custom) and financials-custom-range date picker. Sidebar has cms-nav-financials. UsersAdmin page renders 'Financiën' role option. /admin/analytics has analytics-ratings block. Top notification bar shows 'v0.5.2-Beta'.

issues: Sidebar footer still says 'PearBlue CMS · v0.5-Beta · 2026' (or hardcoded prior label). Confirm dynamic version source; top notification bar correctly shows v0.5.2-Beta. Minor — carry-over from iter 15 action items.

action_items: OPTIONAL: unify sidebar/footer version string with backend /api/changelog.current (v0.5.2-Beta). Not blocking.
OPTIONAL: QuoteCreate.pages is typed 'int' — spec examples pass strings like '5-10' which return 422. Consider Union[int,str] or documenting int-only.
OPTIONAL/SECURITY: enc_secret Fernet fallback — verify SECRETS_KEY is set in /app/backend/.env; if missing, encryption is a no-op noted only by returned {encrypted:false}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2305 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Same recommendation to split into routers/{financials,chat_rating,brevo,mailboxes,users}.py.

/api/admin/financials Emergent-AI cost is a rough heuristic (msg × 800 tokens × pricing). If accuracy matters for finance dashboard, integrate Emergent Universal Key actual usage endpoint instead of local estimate.

/api/admin/chat/ratings uses require_admin (not require_permission('analytics' or 'financials')). Any CMS-access role can view — intentional? Consider gating behind 'analytics' perm to align with sidebar visibility.
QuoteCreate.pages accepts int only; frontend calculator passes wishlist with page counts but the offerte-modal skips pages field. OK, but review request examples used a string range.
MailboxCreate has no email regex validator (EmailStr) — accepts any string. Duplicate check uses lowercased email but MailboxCreate does not enforce email format.
